# Shiftora

> Shiftora is an integrated strategy and systems firm. Governments and enterprises may decide or be required to do more than they can presently carry out.

Shiftora forms its own view, advises those who hold the relevant authority, and remains with a mandate through the work it requires. Sovereign capacity exists when an institution's systems are answerable to its lawful authority and equal to its responsibilities.

## Pages

- [The firm](https://www.shiftora.ai/): The institutional thesis and the role Shiftora assumes.
- [Engagements](https://www.shiftora.ai/engagements): Seven selected systems across public authority and enterprise.
